purpose: Require every first-real-capable immutable cloud request to be created by the official event-evidence preparer, while preserving the frozen quote-free 900-second request semantics.

request_validity.registration_rule: forecast input must be built no later than request_valid_until_taipei

exact_quote_rule.primary_symbol: individual OSE NK225MC month contract only

idempotency.rerun_after_registration: NOOP; never create a second forecast
idempotency.expired_unregistered_request: terminally unregistered; create a new request after fresh analysis

commit_rule: For push-triggered processing, exactly one new/changed live_shadow_requests/*.json file is allowed per request commit.
risk_evidence_rule: risk_state_evidence must be frozen before request creation, be no older than 900 seconds both at request creation and at forecast creation, match decision_input risk modifiers and target date, and carry at least one equally fresh event source when event_state is known.
first_real_registration_event_rule: event_state UNKNOWN is not preparable for the first real request; HAR/SQ UNKNOWN remain allowed and cap confidence through the frozen decision protocol.
next_action: Create immutable requests only through scripts/prepare_jnu_cloud_request_v1.py, then run v1.1 preflight and v3 atomic registration without relaxing any 900-second gate.
prepared_request_rule: request_preparation and risk_state_evidence provenance must cryptographically bind the request to the frozen official event-state and preparation protocols; handcrafted or stale event state is fail-closed.
